program_narrative: Program UTLMON00 is a batch system-monitoring program that ends with GOBACK. It opens the configuration file MONITOR-CONFIG and the indexed file DB2-STATS for input and the output files MONITOR-LOG and ALERT-FILE, captures the time of day into WS-TIMESTAMP and reads every configuration record, passing each to 1310-STORE-CONFIG (not present in the program). The main loop repeats 2000-PROCESS until WS-HOUR = 23: each iteration collects CPU, memory, DASD and DB2 metrics, checks utilisation, response, queue and error thresholds, logs status (copying WS-TIMESTAMP to LOG-TIMESTAMP), generates alerts when THRESHOLD-MET is true, calls the external program ILBOABN0 with WS-MINUTE and captures the time again. All 13 step paragraphs and ILBOABN0 are outside the program, so the monitoring work cannot be traced, and as written the loop condition may never become true. Error conditions handled: a failed OPEN of any of the four files; the error handler displays WS-ERROR-MESSAGE (not declared in the program or its copybooks), sets return code 12 and ends the program immediately.
